items.a: Bodrum is open every day from 11 am to midnight. The open / closed status at the top of the page updates live.

items.q: How do I order for pick-up?
items.a: Use the order form on this site, or call us on 09 84 71 29 70. Choose your time and your order will be ready when you arrive.
Online, the first slot is about 20 minutes after you order. In the evening and at weekends, allow a little longer.
You pay at the counter when you collect. Nothing is charged online.
Yes: the falafel veggie kebab, the vegan dürüm, the veggie and vegan plates, salads and homemade fries.
Chaussée Jules Ferry, 80090 Amiens, on the south-east side of town. The Directions button opens the route in Google Maps.

kebab.metaDescription: Looking for a good kebab in Amiens? Bodrum, chaussée Jules Ferry (south-east Amiens): marinated meat, warm bread, house white sauce. Open 7 days until midnight.
kebab.title: Kebab on chaussée Jules Ferry.
kebab.lead: Bodrum is a kebab shop in south-east Amiens, open every day from 11 am to midnight. Kebab is our main dish, and the one customers mention most in their Google reviews.

sections.p: The meat is marinated, grilled on the spit and sliced as we serve it. It goes into warm bread with lettuce, tomato, red onion and our house white sauce.
The same kebab comes as a dürüm (rolled in a thin flatbread) or on a plate with homemade fries. You can also have it with burrata, avocado, goat’s cheese and honey, or grilled vegetables.
Chaussée Jules Ferry, 80090 Amiens, on the road to Saint-Acheul and Boves. Handy for south-east Amiens and for anyone driving past.

tacos.title: Tacos until midnight.
tacos.lead: At Bodrum, on chaussée Jules Ferry, tacos come with one, two or three meats. Open every day from 11 am to midnight, eat in or take away.

sections.p: Choose your meats and sauce; we add fries and cheese sauce, then put it on the plancha.
We close at midnight, every day. Order online or by phone and your tacos will be ready when you arrive.
Chaussée Jules Ferry, 80090 Amiens, in the south-east of town.
